verdict.rationale: Qapita's cap table product says it lets users "model equity ownership" and gives founders and investors a real-time shared view of ownership, which glancingly touches round modeling and sharing. Nothing describes priced-round scenario modeling specifically. The 'scenario planning' mention belongs to the fund-admin investor portal, which is a different product role, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented priced-round/pro-forma modeling, option pool top-up calculation, SAFE/convertible conversion modeling, dilution analysis, scenario sharing with counsel and investors, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
